title_sq: Apartament ne shitje 2+1+2wc me Post Parkimi tek ish fusha Aviacionit, Tirane (ID 41212153)
description_sq:
Tek ish fusha Aviacionit, ne kompleksin Green City shitet apartament 2+1, siperfaqe 107 m², kati i 6 jo i fundit ne pallat te ri me ashensor, i mobiluar, orientim me diell.
Apartamenti organizohet ne: soxhorno dhe ambient gatimi, 2 dhome gjumi,2 tualete, korridor shperndares, ballkon dhe 1 depo.
Cmimi 215 000 euro.
Disponon dhe post parkimi ne vleren 20 mij euro.
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2wc with Parking Post at the former Aviation Field, Tirana (ID 41212153)
description_en: In the former Aviation field, in the Green City complex, a 2+1 apartment for sale, surface area 107 m², 6th floor, not the last, in a new building with an elevator, furnished, sunny orientation. The apartment is organized in: living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, distribution corridor, balcony and 1 storage room. The price is 215,000 euros. There is also a parking post worth 20,000 euros.
